desc: Second endpoint-scoped SPMI proof, only after 093 passes. Boot only ticket-092 R1 artifact. Reassert exact nub-spmi-a1/hpm2 identity; run bounded WAKEUP, read logical power state 0x20, issue SSPS with target S0 only if state is nonzero, boundedly poll command completion, and verify final state 0. No SLEEP/SHUTDOWN/RESET, IRQ clear/mask, role/VBUS/config, PHY/ATC/DWC3, USB/storage, other endpoint, or fallback. Passive sink only on right port; no charger/powered dock/other host. Pass = exact transaction transcript, S0 verification, and healthy warm-reboot recovery. Stop on mismatch/timeout/SError. Exact hashes/review/maintainer approval required.
